info.title: Component Repository API
info.description: REST API for managing CWL-based workflow components

post.description:
A fresh token for a still-valid one - the frontend's sliding session. It calls this
while the user is active, so a session only ends after a full token lifetime
(JWT_EXPIRES_IN) without any activity. An already expired token can't be refreshed.

400.description: Invalid CWL or file too large

get.description:
Whether `name` is still free for a new component lineage.

`available` reflects the whole catalogue, since component names are globally unique.
`existing` is only filled in when the caller may actually see that component - a name
held by somebody else's draft still reads as taken, just without details.

NOTE: must stay declared above GET /{component_id} - FastAPI matches routes in
declaration order, and "name-availability" would otherwise be parsed as a component id.

post.description:
Package a GitHub repo without persisting it, so the user can review the generated
component (and label its File ports) before POST /components/package creates it.
Mirrors POST /components/parse.

ComponentConfigDto.title: ComponentConfigDto
ComponentConfigDto.description:
The user's decision for one previewed step, keyed by WorkflowStepPreviewDto.step_id.

Exactly one branch: reuse_component_id binds the step to an existing catalogue
Component, or name+domain create a new one from that step's CWL.

ComponentDeletionImpactDto.title: ComponentDeletionImpactDto
ComponentDeletionImpactDto.description:
What deleting this exact version touches - the delete dialog's usage warning.
Other users' private workflows and drafts are only counted, never named.

ComponentPreviewDto.title: ComponentPreviewDto
ComponentPreviewDto.description:
Everything read out of a CWL document without persisting it.

Shared by both upload flows: /components/parse returns exactly this, and the workflow
upload's per-step ComponentPreviewDto extends it with the step it came from.

ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus
ComponentStatus.description: Mirrors WorkflowStatus - a component is staged privately until its creator publishes it.

ComponentWorkflowUsageDto.title: ComponentWorkflowUsageDto
ComponentWorkflowUsageDto.description: A workflow using some version(s) of a component - "Used in these workflows".

ConnectionDto.title: ConnectionDto
ConnectionDto.description: A builder edge: the output `sourcePort` of one component feeding the input `targetPort` of another.

ExistingComponentDto.title: ExistingComponentDto
ExistingComponentDto.description: The component currently holding a name, returned when that name is taken.

ExistingWorkflowDto.title: ExistingWorkflowDto
ExistingWorkflowDto.description: The workflow currently holding a name, returned when that name is in use.

FormatLabelDto.title: FormatLabelDto
FormatLabelDto.description: A hand-written label for a File port without an ontology format, e.g. "RDS".

NameAvailabilityDto.title: NameAvailabilityDto
NameAvailabilityDto.description:
Whether a component name can still be claimed. Lets a caller warn (and offer to
reuse the existing component) while the user is typing, instead of only failing with
a 409 after the whole upload has been submitted.

PackagePreviewDto.title: PackagePreviewDto
PackagePreviewDto.description: A GitHub repo packaged but not persisted (POST /components/package/preview).

PreviewParameterDto.title: PreviewParameterDto
PreviewParameterDto.description:
A previewed component port. Deliberately NOT ParameterDto: that carries a real
uuid primary key, and these are never persisted - the id here is a synthetic,
stable-within-one-response string that only exists to give the UI a list key.
